verdict.rationale: Windmill documents event triggers that run scripts and flows automatically, including webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP and Azure Event Grid. It also offers CRON schedules and conditional flow branches, so automatic event-driven rules are a direct, first-party capability. missing for 10: detailed docs on per-trigger rule or filter conditions (the trigger evidence is a one-line FAQ summary), independent or hands-on corroboration of event triggers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Use schedules, webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP, Azure Event Grid and more.
Branches allow to split the execution of the flow based on a condition.
A Schedule consists of a Script or Flow, its arguments, a CRON expression that controls the execution frequency
